_comment: Mail, calendar, messaging, music, meetings and search results belong to every project and therefore to none (DECISIONS 2026-09-15). Excluded from clustering entirely, never down-weighted. Read by both TS and Python. Matching: 'etld1' on the registrable domain; 'hosts' on the host or any subdomain of it — hosts are recorded without www., and the suffix list makes slack.com a public suffix, so each workspace is its own registrable domain; 'search_paths' on host + path, whole segments only, so the rest of google.com and bing.com (Maps, Flights, Shopping) groups like any site. AI assistants (chatgpt, claude.ai, gemini, perplexity) are deliberately NOT here: a conversation tab has a project-specific title and is opened from, and switched with, the project it serves (DECISIONS 2026-09-15). Message pages of sites that are more than messages (linkedin.com/messaging, facebook.com/messages, x.com/messages, instagram.com/direct) and search pages beyond the big engines are listed as paths the same way; a record of any of these keeps only the site and the listed path (DECISIONS 2026-11-10).
